Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 39 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Isha - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Vinod and Isha stand near him.]

Aarav: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav jumps with joy.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[Aarav waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kavita: "Okay, Vinod."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Isha: "That's great!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Kavita, Vinod and Isha stand near him.]

Isha: "Let's begin."

[Aarav goes jogging in the park.]

Isha (gently): "I knew it!"

[Aarav kicks the football hard.]

Kavita: "Yes, all right."

[Aarav swings on the swing.]

Aarav: "Yes, of course."

[Aarav plays with his dog.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav feeds the birds.]

Vinod: "That was such a fun day!"
